{{Quote|Agee counterpart unit D-2B8 <nowiki>= served aboard patrol frigate Toron Voq // D-2B8 = destroyed</nowiki>|AG-11|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''D-2B8''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] in service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. A counterpart of [[AG-11]] who was fond of him, D-2B8 was stationed aboard the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Toron Voq]]'' when the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was [[Attack on Rhinnal|attacked]] by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] ''[[Red Reaper]]'' in the [[Rhinnal system/Legends|Rhinnal system]] and was destroyed along with the [[Droid/Legends|droid]].<ref name="TOR" />
